department: Department of Agricultural and Biological Engineering (Biomedical Engineering program)

deadline.value: The college review date for Fall is June 1; the program page gives no separate date.
deadline.quote: The application deadlines for all students are as follows: Fall Semester – June 1

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required for regular admission to the MS or PhD.
gre_general.quote: Regular admission into the M.S. or Ph.D. programs requires the student meet the following criteria | Submit GRE scores

toefl_min.value: Department minimum is TOEFL 600 paper-based (96 iBT) if the test applies.
toefl_min.quote: if applicable, a TOEFL score of 600 PBT (96 iBT) or IELTS score of 7.5 or greater

ielts_min.value: Department minimum is an IELTS score of 7.5.
ielts_min.quote: if applicable, a TOEFL score of 600 PBT (96 iBT) or IELTS score of 7.5 or greater

supervisor.value: A member of the biomedical engineering graduate faculty must accept the applicant.
supervisor.quote: Be accepted as a student by a member of the biomedical engineering graduate faculty

entry_route.value: A PhD applicant should hold an M.S. in an engineering discipline; exceptional B.S. holders may be considered.
entry_route.quote: A student entering the Ph.D. program should have an M.S. in an engineering discipline

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

notes: Administered through Agricultural and Biological Engineering for the College of Engineering. The GPA rule for the PhD is 3.00 or higher. No funding rule was found on the program page.
